title: Stir-Fried Dark Brown Sugar Noodles
description: A classic Chinese dish with a twist, featuring velvety noodles cooked to perfection.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil for the noodles.
Cook the noodles according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the fried shallots and cook for 1 minute.
Add the dark brown sugar and cook for another minute.
Add the soft stir-fry sauce and brown sugar syrup, stirring continuously.
Return the cooked noodles to the pan and toss to coat with the sauce.
